The « eTerminal-Canon » embedded terminal works with the CANON Multifunction and enables the 
communication between the MFP and the GESPAGE server. 
 
This embedded software enables secured printing thanks to user’s identification by entering a code on the 
touchscreen or by using a card. 
 
The eTerminal-Canon makes using the MFP easier, more ergonomic and above all more productive in use. A 
simple click enables the user to interact with documents that he wishes to copy and print and this in compliance 
with confidentiality and GDPR regulations. 

Embedded terminal for 
MFP CANON 
Scheme of a network configuration

 Compatible with card readers Cartadis TCM3/TCM4. 
 
 Compatible with Gespage versions 8.2.2 and higher versions. 
 
 MEAP platform required, version 3. 
 Safety / Access management 
 Intuitive interface 
 Personalized welcome to the user. 
 Display of the user credit before and after the 
operation as well as printing tariffs (A4, A3, BW, Color) 
and scan. 
 Printing management 
 The user can select one or more documents 
from the pending Print List, release them, 
delete them or keep them pending. 
 Setup of a printing policy with change of job 
properties (black & white forcing, duplex 
forcing and modification of the number of 
copies). 
 
Accounting and reporting 
 Wide range of available reports. 
 Safe use of CANON MFP by login, login/password, 
code, card (badge reader in option). 
 Possibility to set up access rights for each user or group 
of users.
